answer: The cheapest real defence: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because falcon only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, garden is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any river approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
